  private appendToConversation(userId: string, message: ConversationMessage): void {
    if (!this.conversations.has(userId)) this.conversations.set(userId, [])

    history.push(message)
    while (history.length > MAX_CONVERSATION_HISTORY) history.shift()
  }

      timestamp: processed.original.timestamp,

  }

Current semantics:
- SET hourlyUsed = CASE WHEN resetAt <= now THEN cost ELSE hourlyUsed + cost END
- SET dailyUsed = CASE WHEN resetAt <= now AND resetAt < dayStart THEN cost ELSE dailyUsed + cost END
- SET resetAt = CASE WHEN resetAt <= now THEN nextHour ELSE resetAt END

Careful: daily reset only happens when window expired AND crossing day boundary. When window expired (resetAt <= now) but same day (resetAt >= dayStart), dailyUsed should NOT reset — daily should continue accumulating across hours in the same day. So WHERE daily condition must be: `(resetAt <= now AND resetAt < dayStart) OR dailyUsed + cost <= dailyLimit`.

For hourly: `resetAt <= now OR hourlyUsed + cost <= hourlyLimit`.

Tokenizer:

```ts
function tokenize(input: string): string[] {
  const re = /\s*(?:(("[^"]*")|(\$\d+)|(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)|(<=|>=|<>|!=|=|<|>|\+|-|\*|\/|\(|\)|,|\.)|([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*))/y
```

Sticky regex with lastIndex. Use a while loop.

Actually simpler with global matchAll:

```ts
const TOKEN_RE = /\s*(?<quoted>"[^"]*")|(?<param>\$\d+)|(?<number>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)|(?<op><=|>=|<>|!=|[=<>+\-*/(),.])|(?<word>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g
```

Then tokens = [...input.matchAll(TOKEN_RE)].map(m => m[0].trim()).

Parser with index closure:

```ts
function evaluatePredicate(sql: string, params: unknown[], row: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  const tokens = tokenize(sql)
  let i = 0
  const peek = () => tokens[i]
  const next = () => tokens[i++]
  const isKeyword = (kw: string) => (peek() ?? '').toUpperCase() === kw
  ...
}
```

Implement:

```ts
function parseExpr(): unknown { return parseOr() }

function parseOr(): unknown {
  let left = parseAnd()
  while (isKeyword('OR')) { next(); const right = parseAnd(); left = toBool(left) || toBool(right) }
  return left
}
function parseAnd(): unknown {
  let left = parseComparison()
  while (isKeyword('AND')) { next(); const right = parseComparison(); left = toBool(left) && toBool(right) }
  return left
}
function parseComparison(): unknown {
  const left = parseAdditive()
  const op = peek()
  if (op && ['<=','>=','<>','!=','=','<','>'].includes(op)) {
    next()
    const right = parseAdditive()
    return compare(left, op, right)
  }
  return left
}
function parseAdditive(): unknown {
  let left = parsePrimary()
  while (peek() === '+' || peek() === '-') {
    const op = next()
    const right = parsePrimary()
    left = op === '+' ? toNumber(left) + toNumber(right) : toNumber(left) - toNumber(right)
  }
  return left
}
function parsePrimary(): unknown {
  if (isKeyword('CASE')) return parseCase()
  const tok = next()
  if (tok === undefined) throw new Error(...)
  if (tok === '(') { const v = parseExpr(); expect(')'); return v }
  if (tok.startsWith('$')) return normalizeParam(params[Number(tok.slice(1)) - 1])
  if (/^\d/.test(tok)) return Number(tok)
  if (tok.startsWith('"')) {
    let name = tok.slice(1, -1)
    while (peek() === '.') { next(); const part = next(); name = part.slice(1,-1) }
    return normalizeValue(row[name])
  }
  throw new Error(`不认识的 SQL 片段: ${tok}`)
}
function parseCase(): unknown {
  // CASE WHEN cond THEN val [WHEN ...] [ELSE val] END
  let result: unknown = null
  let matched = false
  while (isKeyword('WHEN')) {
    next()
    const cond = parseExpr()
    expectKeyword('THEN')
    const val = parseExpr()
    if (!matched && toBool(cond)) { result = val; matched = true }
  }
  if (isKeyword('ELSE')) { next(); const fallback = parseExpr(); if (!matched) result = fallback }
  expectKeyword('END')
  return result
}
```

```ts

Implementation of evaluator:

```ts
const h = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const state = {
    row: null as Record<string, unknown> | null,
    whereSql: '',
    whereParams: [] as unknown[],
    sets: [] as Record<string, unknown>[],
  }

  const TOKEN_RE = /\s*(?:"[^"]*"|\$\d+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?|<=|>=|<>|!=|[=<>+\-*/(),.]|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g

  function tokenize(sql: string): string[] {
    return [...sql.matchAll(TOKEN_RE)].map((m) => m[0].trim())
  }

  function normalize(v: unknown): unknown {
    return v instanceof Date ? v.toISOString() : v
  }

  function toNumber(v: unknown): number {
    if (typeof v !== 'number') throw new Error(`期望数值,实际 ${String(v)}`)
    return v
  }

  function toBool(v: unknown): boolean {
    if (typeof v !== 'boolean') throw new Error(`期望布尔,实际 ${String(v)}`)
    return v
  }

  function compare(left: unknown, op: string, right: unknown): boolean {
    const bothNumbers = typeof left === 'number' && typeof right === 'number'
    const a = bothNumbers ? left : String(normalize(left))
    const b = bothNumbers ? right : String(normalize(right))
    switch (op) {
      case '<=': return a <= b
      case '>=': return a >= b
      case '<': return a < b
      case '>': return a > b
      case '=': return a === b
      case '<>':
      case '!=': return a !== b
      default: throw new Error(`不支持的比较算子: ${op}`)
    }
  }

  function evalSql(sql: string, params: unknown[], row: Record<string, unknown>): unknown {
    const tokens = tokenize(sql)
    let i = 0
    const peek = () => tokens[i]
    const take = () => tokens[i++]
    const isKw = (kw: string) => (peek() ?? '').toUpperCase() === kw

    function expectToken(tok: string): void {
      const got = take()
      if (got !== tok) throw new Error(`期望 ${tok},实际 ${String(got)}`)
    }

    function primary(): unknown {
      if (isKw('CASE')) return caseExpr()
      const tok = take()
      if (tok === undefined) throw new Error('SQL 表达式意外结束')
      if (tok === '(') {
        const v = or()
        expectToken(')')
        return v
      }
      if (tok.startsWith('$')) return normalize(params[Number(tok.slice(1)) - 1])
      if (/^\d/.test(tok)) return Number(tok)
      if (tok.startsWith('"')) {
        let column = tok.slice(1, -1)
        while (peek() === '.') {
          take()
          const part = take() ?? ''
          column = part.replace(/^"|"$/g, '')
        }
        return normalize(row[column])
      }
      throw new Error(`无法求值的 SQL 片段: ${tok}`)
    }

    function additive(): unknown {
      let left = primary()
      while (peek() === '+' || peek() === '-') {
        const op = take()
        const right = primary()
        left = op === '+' ? toNumber(left) + toNumber(right) : toNumber(left) - toNumber(right)
      }
      return left
    }

    function comparison(): unknown {
      const left = additive()
      const op = peek()
      if (op && ['<=', '>=', '<>', '!=', '=', '<', '>'].includes(op)) {
        take()
        return compare(left, op, additive())
      }
      return left
    }

    function and(): unknown {
      let left = comparison()
      while (isKw('AND')) { take(); left = toBool(left) && toBool(comparison()) }
      return left
    }

    function or(): unknown {
      let left = and()
      while (isKw('OR')) { take(); left = toBool(left) || toBool(and()) }
      return left
    }

    function caseExpr(): unknown {
      let value: unknown = null
      let matched = false
      while (isKw('WHEN')) {
        take()
        const cond = or()
        if (!isKw('THEN')) throw new Error(`CASE 缺少 THEN,实际 ${String(peek())}`)
        take()
        const branch = or()
        if (!matched && toBool(cond)) { value = branch; matched = true }
      }
      if (isKw('ELSE')) { take(); const fallback = or(); if (!matched) value = fallback }
      if (!isKw('END')) throw new Error(`CASE 缺少 END,实际 ${String(peek())}`)
      take()
      return value
    }

    const result = or()
    if (i !== tokens.length) throw new Error(`SQL 未消费完: ${tokens.slice(i).join(' ')}`)
    return result
  }

  return { state, evalSql }
})
```

Now fake db factory:

```ts
vi.mock('../src/db/index.js', async () => {
  const { PgDialect } = await import('drizzle-orm/pg-core')
  const dialect = new PgDialect()

  const selectChain = () => {
    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    const rows = () => (h.state.row ? [{ ...h.state.row }] : [])
    chain.from = () => chain
    chain.where = () => chain
    chain.limit = () => Promise.resolve(rows())
    chain.then = (res: (v: unknown) => unknown, rej?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(rows()).then(res, rej)
    return chain
  }

  const updateChain = () => {
    let set: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    let whereArg: unknown
    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    chain.set = (v: Record<string, unknown>) => { set = v; return chain }
    chain.where = (w: unknown) => { whereArg = w; return chain }
    chain.returning = () => Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      const wrapper = whereArg as { getSQL?: () => unknown } | undefined
      if (!wrapper || typeof wrapper.getSQL !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('UPDATE 的 where 取不到 getSQL ⇒ 判据失效必须显式报错')
      }
      const q = dialect.sqlToQuery(wrapper.getSQL() as never)
      h.state.whereSql = q.sql
      h.state.whereParams = q.params as unknown[]
      h.state.sets.push(set)

      const oldRow = h.state.row
      if (!oldRow) return []
      if (!h.evalSql(q.sql, q.params as unknown[], oldRow)) return []

      const nextRow: Record<string, unknown> = { ...oldRow }
      for (const [key, expr] of Object.entries(set)) {
        const sqlExpr = expr as { getSQL?: () => unknown }
        if (typeof sqlExpr?.getSQL === 'function') {
          const rendered = dialect.sqlToQuery(sqlExpr.getSQL() as never)
          const value = h.evalSql(rendered.sql, rendered.params as unknown[], oldRow)
          nextRow[key] = typeof value === 'string' && oldRow[key] instanceof Date ? new Date(value) : value
        } else {
          nextRow[key] = expr
        }
      }
      h.state.row = nextRow
      return [nextRow]
    })
    return chain
  }

  return {
    db: { select: () => selectChain(), update: () => updateChain() },
    dbRead: {},
    dbClient: {},
  }
})
```

Careful: `h.evalSql(...)` returns unknown, used in `if (!...)` → truthiness; TS fine but convert: `if (h.evalSql(...) !== true) return []` — better, ensures predicate boolean.

`dialect.sqlToQuery(wrapper.getSQL() as never)` matching repo style casting.

Design mock:

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { PgDialect } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'

const KEY_A = '...a'
const KEY_B = '...b'
const USER_ID = '...u'

const state = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  keys: [] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  usage: {} as Record<string, { callCount: number; lastUsedAt: Date | null; endpoints: Array<{path:string;method:string;count:number}> }>,
  quota: {} as Record<string, Record<string, unknown> | undefined>,
  queries: [] as Array<{ table: string; sql: string; params: unknown[] }>,
}))
```

Mock factory:

```ts
vi.mock('../src/db/index.js', async () => {
  const { getTableName } = await import('drizzle-orm')
  const dialect = new PgDialect()

  const resolve = (tableName: string, fields: Record<string, unknown> | undefined, cond: unknown) => {
    const rendered = cond === undefined ? { sql: '', params: [] as unknown[] } : dialect.sqlToQuery(cond as never)
    state.queries.push({ table: tableName, sql: rendered.sql.toLowerCase(), params: rendered.params as unknown[] })
    const keyId = String(rendered.params[0] ?? '')
    if (tableName === 'developer_api_keys') return state.keys.filter((k) => k.id === keyId)
    if (tableName === 'llm_call_logs') {
      const usage = state.usage[keyId]
      if (!usage) return []
      if (fields && 'callCount' in fields) return [{ callCount: usage.callCount }]
      if (fields && 'lastUsedAt' in fields) return usage.lastUsedAt ? [{ lastUsedAt: usage.lastUsedAt }] : []
      return []
    }
    if (tableName === 'audit_logs') {
      return state.usage[keyId]?.endpoints ?? []
    }
    if (tableName === 'api_key_quotas') {
      const q = state.quota[keyId]
      return q ? [q] : []
    }
    return []
  }

  const chainSelect = (fields?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    let tableName = ''
    let cond: unknown
    const step: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    step.from = (t: unknown) => { tableName = getTableName(t as never); return step }
    step.where = (c: unknown) => { cond = c; return step }
    for (const m of ['orderBy', 'limit', 'groupBy', 'offset']) step[m] = () => step
    const settle = () => resolve(tableName, fields, cond)
    step.then = (res, rej) => Promise.resolve(settle()).then(res, rej)
    step.catch = (rej) => Promise.resolve(settle()).catch(rej)
    return step
  }
  return { db: { select: chainSelect }, dbRead: { select: chainSelect } }
})
```

Careful: `.where()` is called after `.groupBy`? No, order: select().from().where().groupBy().orderBy().limit(). Fine.

```ts
export async function claimRefund(orderNo: string): Promise<OrderOperationResult> {
  const order = await findOrderByNo(orderNo)
  if (!order) return { success: false, reason: '订单不存在' }
  if (order.status !== 'paid') return { success: false, reason: `订单状态(${order.status})不可退款` }
  const claimed = await updateOrderStatus(orderNo, 'refunded', 'paid')
  if (!claimed) return { success: false, reason: '订单状态已变更,退款未落库' }
  return { success: true, order: claimed }
}

export async function abortRefund(orderNo: string): Promise<void> {
  await updateOrderStatus(orderNo, 'paid', 'refunded')
}

export async function refundOrder(orderNo: string, claimed = false): Promise<OrderOperationResult> { ... }
```

  const { userId, amount, reason, idempotencyKey, currentBalance } = input

    return await db.transaction(async (tx) => {

          ON CONFLICT ("related_order_no", "op_type") DO NOTHING
          RETURNING "id"
        `)
        const row = claimed[0] as { id?: string } | undefined
        if (!row?.id) {

        }

      }
      return { success: true, remaining: newBalance }
    })
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof InsufficientBalanceError) return { success: false, remaining: e.remaining }
    throw e
  }
}

Advisory lock helper:

```ts
type PointTx = Parameters<Parameters<typeof db.transaction>[0]>[0]

/**
 * 会员级串行化锚点(F-11)。
 *
 * 账本是追加型:`edu_point_records` 每个会员没有稳定的余额行,锁「上一行流水」无法
 * 阻止并发 INSERT 下一行 —— T1 不改旧行,T2 在 READ COMMITTED 下仍读到同一旧 balance。
 * 这里对会员 ID 取事务级 advisory lock:同一会员的余额读 + 流水写被串行化,事务结束
 * 自动释放;不同会员互不阻塞,也不需要新增表/约束。
 */
async function lockMemberPointLedger(tx: PointTx, memberId: string): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${`edu_point_ledger:${memberId}`}))`)
}
```

Design in order-service:

```ts
/**
 * F-09:退款抢占(paid → refunded)必须发生在调用支付渠道之前。
 * 条件 UPDATE 保证并发退款只有一个请求能把 paid 改为 refunded,其余拿到 0 行。
 * 抢占用 refunded 而非新增中间态(状态机无 refunding),失败时用 abortRefund 回退到 paid。
 */
export async function claimRefund(orderNo: string): Promise<OrderOperationResult> {
  const order = await findOrderByNo(orderNo)
  if (!order) return { success: false, reason: '订单不存在' }
  if (order.status !== 'paid') return { success: false, reason: `订单状态(${order.status})不可退款` }
  const claimed = await updateOrderStatus(orderNo, 'refunded', 'paid')
  if (!claimed) return { success: false, reason: '订单状态已变更,退款未落库' }
  return { success: true, order: claimed }
}

/** F-09:支付渠道退款失败时解除抢占,把订单从 refunded 回退到 paid 以便重试 */
export async function abortRefund(orderNo: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const reverted = await updateOrderStatus(orderNo, 'paid', 'refunded')
  return Boolean(reverted)
}
```

  let table = ''
  const p: any = {

}

function selectChain(resolve: (table: string) => unknown[]) {
  let table = ''
  const p: any = {}
  p.from = (t: unknown) => { table = tableName(t); return p }
  p.where = () => p
  p.orderBy = () => p
  p.offset = () => p
  p.limit = () => Promise.resolve(resolve(table))
  p.then = (onF: any, onR: any) => Promise.resolve(resolve(table)).then(onF, onR)
  return p
}
```

  p.set = (v: any) => { writes.push({table, set: v}); return p }
  p.where = () => p
  p.returning = () => Promise.resolve(rows)

}

}

```ts
export async function refundOrder(
  orderNo: string,
  opts: { alreadyClaimed?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<OrderOperationResult> {
  const alreadyClaimed = opts.alreadyClaimed === true
  const order = await findOrderByNo(orderNo)
  if (!order) return { success: false, reason: '订单不存在' }
  // F-09:alreadyClaimed 表示调用方已用 claimRefund 在调支付渠道前完成 paid→refunded 抢占,
  // 这里不再重复改状态,只做退款副作用(token 扣回/指标)。
  if (!alreadyClaimed && order.status !== 'paid')
    return { success: false, reason: `订单状态(${order.status})不可退款` }
  if ((order.orderType === 2 || order.orderType === 3) && order.userId && !order.productId) {
    try {
      await refundTokenDeduct(order.userId, order.amount, orderNo, '退款')
    } catch (e) {
      // 抢占路径下扣回失败要解除抢占,恢复 F-33「订单保持 paid 等待重试」语义
      if (alreadyClaimed) await abortRefund(orderNo)
      throw e
    }
  }
  let refundedOrder: Order | undefined = order
  if (!alreadyClaimed) {
    refundedOrder = await updateOrderStatus(orderNo, 'refunded', 'paid')
    if (!refundedOrder) return { success: false, reason: '订单状态已变更,退款未落库' }
  }
  ...metrics...
  const updated = await findOrderByNo(orderNo)
  return { success: true, order: updated }
}
```

  request.log.warn({ outBillNo }, 'withdrawal callback missing raw body, reject')
  return reply.code(400).send({ code: 'FAIL', message: '缺少原始报文' })
}

if (timestamp && nonce && signature) {

```

const numericFromSql = (v: any): number | null => {
  const chunks = v?.queryChunks
  if (!Array.isArray(chunks)) return null
  const nums = chunks.filter((c) => typeof c?.value === 'number').map((c) => c.value)
  return nums.length ? nums[nums.length - 1] : null
}
```

    }
    state.balance = next

  }

```ts
function parseSql(sqlObj: any) {
  const chunks = Array.isArray(sqlObj?.queryChunks) ? sqlObj.queryChunks : []
  let text = ''
  const params: unknown[] = []
  for (const c of chunks) {
    if (c && typeof c === 'object' && c.constructor?.name === 'StringChunk') {
      text += String(c.value)
    } else if (c && typeof c === 'object' && c.constructor?.name === 'Param') {
      params.push(c.value)
    }
  }
  return { text, params }
}
```

 * F-11:会员级串行化锚点。
 *
 * 教育积分是追加型账本:每个会员没有一行稳定的"余额行",`ORDER BY createdAt DESC
 * LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE` 锁的是上一行流水,而 T1 只 INSERT 新行、不改旧行 —— T2 在
 * READ COMMITTED 下仍读到同一旧 balance,两边用同一个 beforeBalance 落库;会员没有
 * 任何流水时锁空集,两个事务都从 0 起算。
 *
 * 这里改为对会员 ID 取事务级 advisory lock:同一会员的"读余额 + 写流水"被串行化,
 * 事务提交/回滚时自动释放;不同会员互不阻塞,且无需新表/新约束。
 */
async function lockMemberPointLedger(tx: PointTx, memberId: string): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(
    sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${`edu_point_ledger:${memberId}`}))`,
  )
}
```

```ts
function parseSql(sqlObj: any): { text: string; params: unknown[] } {
  const chunks: any[] = Array.isArray(sqlObj?.queryChunks) ? sqlObj.queryChunks : []
  let text = ''
  const params: unknown[] = []
  for (const c of chunks) {
    if (c && typeof c === 'object' && Array.isArray(c.value)) text += c.value.join('')
    else if (c && typeof c === 'object' && 'value' in c) { text += '?'; params.push(c.value) }
    else if (typeof c === 'string') text += c
    else text += ''
  }
  return { text, params }
}
```

makeSelect(inTx):
```ts
function makeSelect(inTx: boolean) {
  let table: 'records'|'channels'|'points'|undefined
  let cond: unknown
  let order: unknown[] = []
  let limit: number | undefined
  let forUpdate = false
  const run = (): Row[] => {
    if (!table) throw new Error('fake-db: select 缺 from')
    const where = cond === undefined ? {sql:'',params:[]} : compile(cond)
    harness.statements.push({ inTx, kind:'select', table, text: where.sql, params: where.params, forUpdate })
    let rows = rowsOf(table).filter(r => matches(r, cond))
    ...
  }
  const chain: any = { from(t){...}, where(c){...}, orderBy(...), limit(n), for(){ forUpdate = true; return chain }, then(resolve, reject){ return Promise.resolve().then(run).then(resolve, reject) } }
  return chain
}
```

makeInsert(name):
```ts
function makeInsert(name) {
  let values: Row = {}
  const apply = () => {
    harness.seq += 1
    const row = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), createdAt: new Date(BASE + harness.seq*1000), ...values }
    rowsOf(name).push(row)
    harness.statements.push({ inTx, kind:'insert', table:name, text:'insert', params:[], forUpdate:false })
    return [row]
  }
  return { values(v){ values=v; return chain }, returning(projection?) { ... }, then... }
}
```
Returning projection: point-queries calls `.returning()` (no args), so just return full rows. For simplicity support undefined projection only; if given, project.

makeApi(inTx, releases):
```ts
const api = {
  select: (projection?) => makeSelect(inTx),
  insert: (table) => makeInsert(tableOf(table)),
  async execute(expr) {
    const q = compile(expr)
    harness.statements.push({ inTx, kind:'execute', text:q.sql, params:q.params, forUpdate:false })
    if (/pg_advisory_xact_lock/i.test(q.sql)) {
      const release = await acquire(String(q.params[0] ?? ''))
      releases?.push(release)
    }
    return []
  },
  async transaction(cb) {
    const txReleases: Array<()=>void> = []
    const tx = makeApi(true, txReleases)
    try { return await cb(tx) } finally { for (const r of txReleases.reverse()) r() }
  },
}
```

win32.relative = function relative(from, to) {
  ...
  const fromOrig = resolve(from);
  const toOrig = resolve(to);

  const to = toOrig.toLowerCase();
  if (from === to) return '';
  ...

```ts
const dbState = vi.hoisted(() => ({ selects: 0 }))

vi.mock('../src/db/index.js', () => {
  function makeChain() {
    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    chain.from = () => chain
    chain.where = () => chain
    chain.groupBy = () => chain
    chain.orderBy = () => chain
    chain.limit = () => chain
    chain.offset = () => chain
    chain.then = (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => void) => resolve([])
    return chain
  }
  const db = {
    select: vi.fn(() => {
      dbState.selects++
      return makeChain()
    }),
    insert: vi.fn(() => makeChain()),
    update: vi.fn(() => makeChain()),
    delete: vi.fn(() => makeChain()),
    execute: vi.fn(async () => []),
  }
  return { db, dbRead: db }
})
```

```ts
/**
 * F-27 回归锁(2026-11-11)。
 *
 * 病灶:原子回滚把 checkpointId 与 meta.files[].path 直接 join 到工作区/快照根,
 *       `..` 折叠后可越出工作区任意读写(路由层也只限长度不限字符集)。
 * 判据:checkpointId 仅 [A-Za-z0-9_-];meta 内 `../`、绝对路径、盘符路径一律拒绝,
 *       越界条目不写出工作区外任何文件;正常相对路径行为不变。
 */
import { describe, it, expect, afterAll } from 'vitest'
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, rmSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import {
  createAtomicCheckpoint,
  executeAtomicRollback,
  isSafeCheckpointId,
  planAtomicRollback,
} from '../src/services/atomic-rollback.js'

const tmpRoots: string[] = []
function makeRoot(prefix = 'ihui-f27-'): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix))
  tmpRoots.push(dir)
  return dir
}

afterAll(() => {
  for (const dir of tmpRoots) {
    try {
      rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
    } catch {
      /* 临时目录清理失败不影响判定 */
    }
  }
})

function readMeta(dir: string) {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, 'meta.json'), 'utf-8')) as AtomicMeta
}
```

### 1. 源码现状核对（apps/api/src/routes/payment-gateway.ts，文件在工作树中没有改动）
四处回调在 `result.success === false` 时都会先释放幂等锁，再返回可重试的失败响应，不再写入 complete：

| 位置 | 平台 | 失败处理 | 行号 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 微信 notify | `completeOrderWithSaga` | `paymentIdempotency.fail(...)` + `500 {code:'FAIL'}` | 737-749 |
| 支付宝 notify | `completeOrder` | `fail(...)` + 文本 `'fail'` | 1249-1261 |
| PayPal capture | `completeOrder` | `fail(...)` + `500` | 1571-1583 |
| PayPal webhook | `completeOrder` | `fail(...)` + `500` | 1742-1754 |

在带 `if (result.success && result.order)` 的代码块之外，只有成功分支会调用 `complete`；`catch` 分支的原有语义保持不变（仍然是调用 `fail` 并返回失败响应）；成功路径和 `order-service.ts` 都未改动。

### 2. 幂等服务的实际接口（apps/api/src/plugins/payment-idempotency.ts）
- `acquire(paymentId, idemKey, ttlSec?)` → `new | processing | completed | unknown`
- `complete(paymentId, idemKey, result?, ttlSec?)` —— 写入 24h completed 状态，写失败会抛出错误
- `fail(paymentId, idemKey, errorMsg?)` —— 删除键、释放锁，允许支付平台重投（:177-189）
- `preHandler(...)` —— 用请求头设置幂等键的前置处理

也就是说，实际接口是 `fail` 方法，不需要对幂等服务做任何改动（没有扩大到修改幂等服务的范围）。

## Windows 路径处理说明

先用 `resolve()` 归一（折叠 `..`、识别盘符/UNC/驱动相对路径 `C:rel`），再用 `relative(root, abs)` 判定：空串=根本身、`isAbsolute(back)`=跨盘或绝对路径、`back === '..'` 或 `..\` 前缀=越界。Node 的 `path.win32.relative` 内部对盘符与路径做小写比较，因此大小写差异不会产生误判（同目录大小写变体放行，异盘符被 `isAbsolute` 拦下）；反斜杠穿越在 POSIX/Windows 上均被 `resolve` 归一后拦截。

if (existing.isActive === 1) {

    .from(oauthPrivateKeys)

}
```

I'll implement:

```ts
type Flow = { id: string; status: number; amount: number; userId: string | null }

function makeTx(flow: Flow | null, counters: { flowUpdates: number; marginUpdates: number }) {
  return {
    select: () => {
      const chain = {
        from: () => chain,
        where: () => chain,
        for: () => chain,
        limit: async () => (flow ? [flow] : []),
      }
      return chain
    },
    update: (table: unknown) => ({
      set: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
        where: async () => {
          if (table === withdrawalFlows) { counters.flowUpdates += 1; ... apply status }
          else { counters.marginUpdates += 1 }
        },
      }),
    }),
  }
}
```

## 结论

**HEAD 已修复该缺陷**，本次未改动 `apps/api/src/services/order-service.ts`（`git status` 确认只有新建测试文件），仅补齐回归测试。

**HEAD 现行实现**（`order-service.ts:687-728`）：
- 顺序已是「先 `refundTokenDeduct` 扣回，成功后才条件 `updateOrderStatus(paid→refunded)`」。
- 扣回抛错时不再吞错：catch 中（若是 alreadyClaimed 分支先 `abortRefund` 回 paid）直接 `throw`，订单保持 `paid`，调用方拿到失败可重试；`refundTokenDeduct` 以 `refund:<orderNo>` 幂等，重试不会二次扣减。
- `alreadyClaimed: true` 分支：先 `abortRefund(orderNo)`（`refunded→paid`）再抛出，未引入新队列/标记表，复用了 F-09 既有的抢占/解除抢占设施，是既有设施下的最小方案。
- 正常路径（扣回成功）的状态流转、返回结构、`recordPaymentRefund`/`recordOrderSample`/`recordPaymentSample` 打点位置均未改变。

## 新增测试

`g:\IHUI-AI\apps\api\tests\f-33-refund-token-rollback.test.ts`（6 例，沿用 `order-service-refund-product-guard.test.ts` 的轻量 mock 范式，未用 fastify）：
1. 扣回抛错 → `refundOrder` 抛错，状态仍 `paid`，未落 `refunded`，退款指标零调用；
2. 失败后重试 → 第二次扣回成功才落 `refunded`，`refundTokenDeduct` 调用两次（幂等键不变）；
3. `alreadyClaimed` 分支扣回抛错 → 状态回滚 `paid` 且抛错，不返回 success；
4. `alreadyClaimed` 分支扣回成功 → 保持 `refunded` 并返回 success；
5. 正常路径调用顺序为 `deduct` → `status:refunded`；
6. 带 `productId` 的 VIP 单不扣回 token，行为不变。

## 结论

**该缺陷在 HEAD 上已修复**，本次未改任何生产代码，只补了回归测试。

### 1. HEAD 现状核对（缺陷已不存在）

- `apps/api/src/routes/payment-extended.ts:146-149`：注释与实现均为「nonce 必须在业务事务成功之后才落库」，幂等改由事务内 `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` + 仅处理 `status 0/1` 保证。
- 同文件 `:221-229`：`consumeNotifyNonce('withdrawal', …)` 移到事务提交之后；`replayed → SUCCESS(重复通知)`，`unavailable → 500 FAIL`。
- 同文件 `:232-236`：catch 改为 `reply.code(500).send({ code: 'FAIL', message: '处理失败,请稍后重试' })`，不再 ACK SUCCESS。
- 证据提交：`8ee5b47dcf6`（提交说明明确写 "F-17 nonce 消费后移到业务事务成功之后;处理失败回 FAIL/500"），`920fbfc47f4` 的 F-16 改动保留了该语义。该文件当前无未提交改动，故为 HEAD 内容。
- `consumeNotifyNonce`（`services/wechat-pay.ts:165-180`）无 release 接口，但也不需要：现方案是「成功后才落标记」，失败时标记根本没写，重投天然可重放，未改动 nonce 服务。

### 2. 改动

- 仅新增 `g:\IHUI-AI\apps\api\tests\f-17-withdrawal-callback-nonce.test.ts`（4 个用例，已按仓库门禁注入溯源水印）。
- 生产文件、5 个他人修改的测试、配置/迁移/SQL 均未触碰；无任何 git 写操作。

### 3. 测试结果

- `npx vitest run tests/f-17-withdrawal-callback-nonce.test.ts`：**4 passed**。
  - 事务抛错 ⇒ 500 + `FAIL`，nonce 零调用、无去重记录，流水仍 `status=0`；
  - 失败后同头（同 timestamp/nonce）重投 ⇒ 200 `SUCCESS`/`OK`（非「重复通知」），nonce 仅消费 1 次，流水置 2、保证金释放 1 次；
  - 成功后再投 ⇒ 200 `SUCCESS`/「重复通知」，流水/保证金更新次数仍为 1（不二次释放冻结）；
  - 事务成功但 nonce 返回 `unavailable` ⇒ 500 + `FAIL`。
  - 用例还断言事件序 `tx-commit → nonce-consume`，直接钉住「nonce 后置」，变异回旧顺序会翻红。
- 既有相关测试：`f16-withdraw-callback-rawbody`、`payment-extended-withdrawal-notify`、`distribution-withdraw-freeze-gate` 共 **10 passed**。
- `npx eslint tests/f-17-withdrawal-callback-nonce.test.ts`：**0 error**（无生产文件改动，故仅此文件需 lint）。

### 4. 并发/重放语义判断

- 同一报文并发重投：两请求都可能进入事务，但行锁串行化 + `status 0/1` 守卫保证只有一次资金副作用；nonce 的 `SET NX` 只让一方得到 `ok`，另一方 `replayed`，双方都回 SUCCESS。
- 失败后重投：事务整体回滚且 nonce 未写，重投会真正重放业务，不会落入「重复通知」黑洞。
- 提交成功但响应丢失 / 进程在提交后崩溃：重投时事务命中 `status=2/3` 幂等空转，nonce 判 `replayed` 或重新 `ok`，均回 SUCCESS，不重复释放。

### 5. 需拍板项

无阻塞项。仅两点残留观察（均属既有设计、超出本票范围，未改动）：
1. `flow not found` 与 `status=2/3` 分支仍回 SUCCESS 并消费 nonce——若回调早于本地流水落库则不会重试；但 `applyWithdrawal` 是先落流水再发起转账，正常路径不成立。
2. nonce 存储不可用时该回调会持续 500 直到微信重试耗尽（业务已提交、数据安全），属 fail-closed 既定口径。

1. **权限闸**：沿用既有 `requireAdmin`（不做改动），失败码与全站管理端点一致——未登录 401、非管理员 `403 {"code":403,"message":"需要管理员权限"}`（含管理员 TOTP 闸，档位由 `ADMIN_TOTP_MODE` 决定）。未引入新权限点，避免与既有 admin 面语义分叉。
2. **唯一 active 保护**（`/revoke`）：
   - 仅当目标 `isActive === 1` 时，按 `clientId`（provider 维度，与 `oauth-authorization-server.ts:queryActiveSigningKeys` 的取键口径一致）做 `count()` 统计；
   - 统计值恰为 1 ⇒ `409`，文案「该密钥是当前唯一生效的签名密钥,吊销会导致 JWKS 为空;请先轮换出新的生效密钥」，且不发起 UPDATE；
   - 已失效密钥重复吊销照旧幂等放行（不额外查询）；`count≠1` 不误拦；`rotate`/`generate`/密钥生成与签名逻辑未动。
   - 未新增审计：本文件原本没有审计设施，按约束不新造。
3. **并发残余**：count 与 UPDATE 之间仍有秒级读-判-写窗口（与原文件既有注释同性质），并发双吊销极窄场景仍可能打空；已通过「管理员专用 + 前端需先 rotate」把风险降到操作级，未引入事务/条件更新以免改动业务链。

Careful: if we release in finally at end of IIFE, but connection persists after handler returns (socket remains open, close listener releases). Or use helper `releaseSlot()`. To satisfy try/finally requirement: wrap the body in try/catch and set `handedOff = true` when successful; finally { if (!handedOff) releaseSlot() }. With default 1 if not set. Let's implement:

```ts
export function shouldMarkTerminalFailed(attemptsMade: number, maxAttempts: number | undefined | null): boolean {
  const max = typeof maxAttempts === 'number' && Number.isFinite(maxAttempts) && maxAttempts >= 1
    ? Math.floor(maxAttempts) : 1
  const made = typeof attemptsMade === 'number' && Number.isFinite(attemptsMade) && attemptsMade > 0 ? Math.floor(attemptsMade) : 0
  return made + 1 >= max
}
```
So attemptsMade=0, attempts=3 => 1>=3 false → retryable. attemptsMade=2 => 3>=3 true → terminal. attemptsMade=0, max=1 => terminal.

Now design pure functions in same file:

```ts
export type CsJoinVerdict =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; reason: 'session_missing' | 'session_not_owner' | 'session_closed' | 'agent_not_assigned' | 'session_not_active' }

export interface CsSessionLike {
  userId: string
  agentId?: string | null
  status: string
}

const CS_SESSION_TERMINAL_STATUSES = new Set(['closed', 'resolved', 'rejected'])

export function judgeSessionJoin(
  session: CsSessionLike | null | undefined,
  userId: string,
  isAgent: boolean,
  agentId?: string,
): CsJoinVerdict {
  if (!session) return { ok: false, reason: 'session_missing' }
  if (isAgent) {
    if (!agentId || session.agentId !== agentId) return { ok: false, reason: 'agent_not_assigned' }
    if (session.status !== 'active') return { ok: false, reason: 'session_not_active' }
    return { ok: true }
  }
  if (session.userId !== userId) return { ok: false, reason: 'session_not_owner' }
  if (CS_SESSION_TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(session.status)) return { ok: false, reason: 'session_closed' }
  return { ok: true }
}

export function judgeAgentBroadcast(
  session: CsSessionLike | null | undefined,
  agentId: string,
): { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: 'session_missing' | 'agent_not_assigned' | 'session_not_active' } {
  if (!session) return { ok: false, reason: 'session_missing' }
  if (session.agentId !== agentId) return { ok: false, reason: 'agent_not_assigned' }
  if (session.status !== 'active') return { ok: false, reason: 'session_not_active' }
  return { ok: true }
}
```

Add exported pure function near TERMINAL_STATUSES:

```ts
/**
 * F-88 回归:判断当前失败是否已到最后一次 attempt(只有最后一次才可写终态 failed)。
 *
 * BullMQ 在处理器执行期间不会递增 attemptsMade(第 1 次为 0,第 N 次为 N-1),
 * 该字段仅在 moveToFinished/retryJob 里 +1 ⇒ 用它判断「还有没有下一次重试」。
 * 拿不到可靠值时按「最后一次」处理(保持原有置 failed 语义,不让任务悬空)。
 */
export function shouldMarkTerminalFailed(
  attemptsMade: number | undefined | null,
  maxAttempts: number | undefined | null,
): boolean {
  const max =
    typeof maxAttempts === 'number' && Number.isFinite(maxAttempts) && maxAttempts >= 1
      ? Math.floor(maxAttempts)
      : 1
  const made =
    typeof attemptsMade === 'number' && Number.isFinite(attemptsMade) && attemptsMade > 0
      ? Math.floor(attemptsMade)
      : 0
  return made + 1 >= max
}
```

Wait: "拿不到可靠值时按最后一次处理" — hmm, if attemptsMade undefined and maxAttempts=3, made becomes 0 → 1>=3 false → retry. That's not "按最后一次". If maxAttempts missing → 1 → terminal. If attemptsMade missing but max known → treat as first attempt → continue retry. That's safe for not prematurely failing. Adjust comment accordingly.

Catch block:

```ts
      } catch (err) {
        // 未预期的异常(处理函数内部的错误已在内部 catch)
        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
        server.log.error({ jobId: job.id, taskId, err: errMsg }, 'batch-worker: 批量任务处理异常')
        // F-88:仅在最后一次 attempt 写终态 failed;否则回写进行态后 rethrow,让 BullMQ 继续重试。
        if (shouldMarkTerminalFailed(job.attemptsMade, job.opts?.attempts)) {
          await updateBatchTaskStatus(redis, taskId, 'failed', {
            _errorMessage: errMsg,
          }).catch(() => {})
        } else {
          // 保留非终态:若任务已被取消/已完成(takeover),不要覆盖回 in_progress
          const current = await getTask(redis, taskId).catch(() => null)
          if (current && !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(current.status)) {
            await updateBatchTaskStatus(redis, taskId, 'in_progress').catch(() => {})
          }
        }
        throw err
      }
```

function extractApiKey(request: FastifyRequest): { key: string; source: 'header' | 'query' } | null {
  const auth = request.headers.authorization
  if (auth?.startsWith('Bearer ')) { ... return {key, source:'header'} }
  const query = request.query as { api_key?: string }
  if (query.api_key) {
    request.log.warn({ url: request.url.split('?')[0] }, 'v1/realtime 使用 query 传递 api_key 已废弃,请改用 Authorization: Bearer')
    return { key: query.api_key, source: 'query' }
  }
  return null
}

Implement helper:
```ts
interface RealtimeUsage { input_tokens?: number; output_tokens?: number; total_tokens?: number }

const billedResponses = new Set<string>()
function meterUpstreamUsage(raw: string, ctx: { apiKeyId: string; userId: string; model: string; clientIp: string; log: FastifyRequest['log'] }): void {
  let parsed: unknown
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw) } catch { return }
  const event = parsed as { type?: string; response?: { id?: string; usage?: RealtimeUsage } }
  if (event.type !== 'response.done' || !event.response) return
  const usage = event.response.usage
  if (!usage) return
  const promptTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.input_tokens ?? 0))
  const completionTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.output_tokens ?? 0))
  const totalTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.total_tokens ?? promptTokens + completionTokens))
  if (totalTokens <= 0) return
  const responseId = event.response.id ?? ''
  if (responseId) { if (billedResponses.has(responseId)) return; billedResponses.add(responseId) }
  void recordCall({ apiKeyId, userId, model, prompt: '', response: null, promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, latencyMs: 0, status: 'success', clientIp, metadata: { protocol: 'realtime', realtimeResponseId: responseId || null } })
    .catch(err => log.warn(...))
}
```
recordCall itself never rejects (it catches), but its signature returns Promise<RecordCallResult>; `.catch` fine but redundant. Use void recordCall(...). ```ts
// ===========================================================================
// API Key 校验(复用共享鉴权判据,WS upgrade 场景专用)
// ===========================================================================
//
// F-86(2026-11-11):原实现只查 developer_api_keys.status === 'active',
// expiresAt / allowedIps / allowedModels / per-model rateLimit 全部绕过,且从 query 取 key。
// WS upgrade 无法直接挂 requireApiKeyAuth preHandler(升级后才是 socket,且历史客户端
// 只带 key、不带 X-Api-Secret),故这里抽出异步校验函数,判据全部复用 api-key-auth /
// key-rate-window-service 的既有导出,不另写一套。

/** WS 鉴权失败原因。 */
export type RealtimeAuthFailureReason =
  | 'missing_key'
  | 'invalid_key'
  | 'expired'
  | 'ip_denied'
  | 'model_denied'
  | 'rate_limited'
  | 'quota_exceeded'
  | 'backend_unavailable'

export type RealtimeAuthResult =
  | { ok: true; apiKeyId: string; userId: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: RealtimeAuthFailureReason; message: string; retryAfter?: number }

/** 鉴权所需的 Key 快照(纯数据,便于单测不连库)。 */
export interface RealtimeKeySnapshot {
  id: string
  userId: string
  status: string
  /** users.status:0=禁用 1=正常 3=注销 */
  userStatus: number
  expiresAt: Date | null
  allowedIps: string[] | null
  blockedIps: string[] | null
  allowedModels: string[] | null
}

function authFailed(reason: RealtimeAuthFailureReason, message: string): RealtimeAuthResult {
  return { ok: false, reason, message }
}

/**
 * 纯判据:与 plugins/api-key-auth.authenticateApiKey 同一套共享检查函数
 * (checkExpiresAt / checkKeyIpAcl / checkAllowedModels),不重复实现匹配算法。
 */
export function evaluateRealtimeKey(
  snapshot: RealtimeKeySnapshot,
  model: string,
  requestIp: string,
): RealtimeAuthResult {
  // 与主鉴权链路一致:Key 状态 + 账号状态(SDB-29)双检
  if (snapshot.status !== 'active' || snapshot.userStatus !== 1) {
    return authFailed('invalid_key', 'Invalid or revoked API key')
  }
  const expiresCheck = checkExpiresAt(snapshot.expiresAt)
  if (!expiresCheck.ok) return authFailed('expired', expiresCheck.reason ?? 'API Key 已过期')
  const ipCheck = checkKeyIpAcl(
    { blockedIps: snapshot.blockedIps, allowedIps: snapshot.allowedIps, requestIp },
    ipInList,
  )
  if (!ipCheck.ok) return authFailed('ip_denied', ipCheck.reason ?? 'IP 不在白名单')
  const modelCheck = checkAllowedModels(snapshot.allowedModels, model)
  if (!modelCheck.ok) return authFailed('model_denied', modelCheck.reason ?? '模型不在白名单')
  return { ok: true, apiKeyId: snapshot.id, userId: snapshot.userId }
}

/** 余额/配额预检的保守 token 预估(与主鉴权链路无 max_tokens 时的默认值一致)。 */
const REALTIME_ESTIMATED_TOKENS = 1000

/** 从请求中提取 API Key:优先 header Authorization: Bearer(F-86:不再默认走 query)。 */
export function extractApiKey(
  request: FastifyRequest,
): { key: string; source: 'header' | 'query' } | null {
  const auth = request.headers.authorization
  if (typeof auth === 'string' && auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    const key = auth.slice('Bearer '.length).trim()
    if (key) return { key, source: 'header' }
  }
  // 兼容期:历史客户端把 key 放在 query(会进访问日志)。保留但告警,下一版本移除。
  const query = request.query as { api_key?: string } | undefined
  if (query?.api_key) {
    request.log.warn(
      { path: request.url.split('?')[0] },
      'v1/realtime: api_key 放在 query 已废弃(会进入访问日志),请改用 Authorization: Bearer',
    )
    return { key: query.api_key, source: 'query' }
  }
  return null
}

/**
 * WS 鉴权 + 配额预检。
 * 失败一律 fail-close(WS 会话直接消耗平台上游 Key,不能放行未验证连接)。
 */
export async function authenticateRealtimeApiKey(
  request: FastifyRequest,
  model: string,
): Promise<RealtimeAuthResult> {
  const credential = extractApiKey(request)
  if (!credential) return authFailed('missing_key', 'API key required')

  let joined: { key: typeof developerApiKeys.$inferSelect; userStatus: number } | undefined
  try {
    ;[joined] = await db
      .select({ key: developerApiKeys, userStatus: users.status })
      .from(developerApiKeys)
      .innerJoin(users, eq(developerApiKeys.userId, users.id))
      .where(eq(developerApiKeys.key, credential.key))
      .limit(1)
  } catch (err) {
    request.log.error({ err }, 'v1/realtime: api key lookup failed')
    return authFailed('backend_unavailable', '鉴权服务暂不可用')
  }
  if (!joined) return authFailed('invalid_key', 'Invalid API key')

  const row = joined.key
  const evaluated = evaluateRealtimeKey(
    {
      id: row.id,
      userId: row.userId,
      status: row.status,
      userStatus: joined.userStatus,
      expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
      allowedIps: (row.allowedIps as string[] | null) ?? null,
      blockedIps: (row.blockedIps as string[] | null) ?? null,
      allowedModels: (row.allowedModels as string[] | null) ?? null,
    },
    model,
    request.ip,
  )
  if (!evaluated.ok) return evaluated

  // per-model RPM/TPM:与主鉴权链路同一个共享函数
  const rl = await checkPerModelRateLimit(
    row.id,
    model,
    REALTIME_ESTIMATED_TOKENS,
    row.perModelRpmLimit?.[model],
    row.perModelTpmLimit?.[model],
  )
  if (!rl.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: 'rate_limited',
      message: rl.reason === 'tpm' ? '超过单模型 TPM 限制' : '超过单模型 RPM 限制',
      retryAfter: rl.retryAfter,
    }
  }
  if (rl.backendUnavailable) {
    // 与会话级 WS 一致:限流后端不可用时 fail-close(该端点 100% billable)
    return authFailed('rate_limited', '限流后端不可用,请稍后重试')
  }

  // 余额/配额预检:复用 relay-billing-service.checkQuota(含 Key 级窗口 + 组池/个人余额)
  try {
    const quota = await checkQuota(row.id, REALTIME_ESTIMATED_TOKENS, { clientIp: request.ip })
    if (!quota.allowed) {
      const reasonMap: Record<string, string> = {
        no_balance_token: 'Token 余额不足',
        no_balance_cost: '成本余额不足',
        key_not_found: 'API Key 不存在',
        key_revoked: 'API Key 已被吊销',
        subscription_window_exceeded: '订阅窗口额度已用尽',
        ip_blocked: 'IP 在黑名单',
        ip_not_allowed: 'IP 不在白名单',
        key_rate_window_exceeded: '超过 Key 级限流窗口',
      }
      return authFailed(
        'quota_exceeded',
        reasonMap[quota.reason ?? ''] ?? '额度不足,无法建立会话',
      )
    }
  } catch (err) {
    request.log.error({ err }, 'v1/realtime: quota precheck failed')
    return authFailed('backend_unavailable', '额度服务暂不可用')
  }

  return { ok: true, apiKeyId: row.id, userId: row.userId }
}
```

Fake server: same as existing. Fake socket with `on` capturing listeners:
```ts
function makeSocket() {
  const handlers = new Map<string, ((...args: unknown[]) => unknown)[]>()
  const socket = {
    send: vi.fn(),
    close: vi.fn(),
    readyState: 1,
    on: vi.fn((event: string, cb: (...args: unknown[]) => unknown) => {
      const list = handlers.get(event) ?? []
      list.push(cb)
      handlers.set(event, list)
    }),
  }
  return { socket, emit: (event: string, ...args: unknown[]) => Promise.all((handlers.get(event) ?? []).map((cb) => cb(...args))) }
}
```

Careful: socket.on('close', async () => ...) returns promise; emit awaits.

async function handleRealtimeConnection(socket: WebSocket, request: FastifyRequest): Promise<void> {
  // --- 1. 模型参数(鉴权的 allowedModels 判据需要 model) ---
  const query = request.query as { model?: string }
  const model = query.model ?? ''
  if (!model) {
    safeClose(socket, CLOSE_CODE.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED, 'Missing model parameter')
    return
  }

  // --- 2. 鉴权 + 配额预检(F-86:共享判据,不再只查 status) ---
  const auth = await authenticateRealtimeApiKey(request, model)
  if (!auth.ok) {
    request.log.warn({ reason: auth.reason }, 'v1/realtime connection rejected')
    safeClose(
      socket,
      auth.reason === 'model_denied' ? CLOSE_CODE.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED : CLOSE_CODE.AUTH_FAILED,
      auth.message,
    )
    return
  }

  // --- 3. 模型白名单校验 ---
  ...

Add helper before handleRealtimeConnection (after safeClose):

```ts
/** 上游 response.done 的 usage 形状(OpenAI Realtime)。 */
interface RealtimeUsageFrame {
  type?: string
  response?: {
    id?: string
    usage?: { input_tokens?: number; output_tokens?: number; total_tokens?: number }
  }
}

/**
 * F-86:按上游 response.done 的真实 usage 记量(每个 response 记一次,按响应 id 去重)。
 * 无 usage 的帧(含 dashscope 未提供 usage 的转换帧)不记 —— 见票据遗留缺口。
 */
function meterRealtimeResponseUsage(
  raw: string,
  ctx: {
    apiKeyId: string
    userId: string
    model: string
    clientIp: string
    billedResponseIds: Set<string>
    log: FastifyRequest['log']
  },
): void {
  let frame: RealtimeUsageFrame
  try {
    frame = JSON.parse(raw) as RealtimeUsageFrame
  } catch {
    return
  }
  if (frame.type !== 'response.done' || !frame.response) return
  const usage = frame.response.usage
  if (!usage) return
  const promptTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.input_tokens ?? 0))
  const completionTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.output_tokens ?? 0))
  const totalTokens = Math.max(0, Number(usage.total_tokens ?? promptTokens + completionTokens))
  if (totalTokens <= 0) return
  const responseId = frame.response.id ?? ''
  if (responseId) {
    if (ctx.billedResponseIds.has(responseId)) return
    ctx.billedResponseIds.add(responseId)
  }
  void recordCall({
    apiKeyId: ctx.apiKeyId,
    userId: ctx.userId,
    model: ctx.model,
    prompt: '',
    response: null,
    promptTokens,
    completionTokens,
    totalTokens,
    latencyMs: 0,
    status: 'success',
    clientIp: ctx.clientIp,
    metadata: { protocol: 'realtime', realtimeResponseId: responseId || null },
  })
}

It's directly necessary for "api_key 只从 Authorization: Bearer 读取为主" to function. I'd say yes, necessary. But careful: preValidation runs before upgrade; reply 401 otherwise. Implement:

```ts
/**
 * 升级前 fail-fast:只拦"完全无凭据"的握手(pass 条件与 extractApiKey 同源)。
 * F-86:wsUpgradeRequiresCredential() 默认只看 query token,会让 Authorization: Bearer 客户端
 * 在升级前就被 401,故这里按本端点的凭据形态(header Bearer / query api_key / query token)判定。
 */
function realtimeUpgradeRequiresCredential(): (request, reply) => Promise<void> {
  return async (request, reply) => {
    const auth = request.headers.authorization
    const q = request.query as Record<string, string | undefined> | undefined
    const hasHeader = typeof auth === 'string' && auth.startsWith('Bearer ') && auth.length > 'Bearer '.length
    const hasQuery = Boolean(q?.api_key || q?.token)
    if (!hasHeader && !hasQuery) {
      await reply.status(401).send({ code: 401, message: 'WS 连接缺少凭据' })
    }
  }
}
```

export function canRemoveMember(
  operatorRole: TenantRole,
  targetRole: TenantRole,
  ownerCount: number,
): Decision {

  if (targetRole === 'owner') {

  }
  return allowed
}
```

Design of fix:

```ts
import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify'
import type { Worker } from 'bullmq'
import { createWorker, QUEUE_NAMES, type EmailJobData, type Job } from '../plugins/queue.js'
import { sendEmail } from '../services/email-service.js'

/** 收件人脱敏:只保留前 2 位本地名 + 域名,不打印正文 */
function maskRecipient(email: string): string {
  const at = email.indexOf('@')
  if (at < 1) return '***'
  return `${email.slice(0, 2)}***${email.slice(at)}`
}

export function startEmailWorker(server: FastifyInstance): Worker {
  return createWorker<EmailJobData>(server, QUEUE_NAMES.email, async (job: Job<EmailJobData>) => {
    const result = await sendEmail({...})
    server.log.info({...}, 'email job processed')
    // F-36: sendEmail 失败不抛错(返回 sent:false),worker 若正常返回 BullMQ 会记成功,
    // 既有 attempts/backoff 与 dead-letter 全部失效 → 邮件静默丢失。
    // stub(未配置 SMTP/Resend 的本地/测试)是预期行为,必须保持成功,否则本地队列会无限重试。
    if (!result.sent && !result.stub) {
      throw new Error(
        `email send failed (jobId=${job.id ?? 'unknown'}, to=${maskRecipient(job.data.to)}, provider=${result.provider}): ${result.error ?? 'unknown'}`,
      )
    }
    return result
  })
}
```

Design for cron file:

```ts
function buildTask(expr: string): ScheduledTask | null {
  if (!cron.validate(expr)) {
    logger.error(`[backup] cron 表达式非法,拒绝调度(cron: "${expr}")`)
    return null
  }
  try {
    const task = cron.schedule(...)
    logger.info(...)
    return task
  } catch (e) {
    logger.error('[backup] cron 调度创建失败', {...})
    return null
  }
}
```

}
const prev = scheduledTask

Write code carefully preserving provenance header/footer.

```ts
let scheduledTask: ScheduledTask | null = null

/**
 * 按表达式建任务(先 validate 再 schedule)。
 * 失败时返回 null 且 **不修改** scheduledTask —— 调用方据此保留旧的调度。
 */
function scheduleWith(expr: string): ScheduledTask | null {
  if (!cron.validate(expr)) {
    logger.error(`[backup] cron 表达式非法,拒绝调度(保留既有调度;cron: "${expr}")`)
    return null
  }
  try {
    const task = cron.schedule(
      expr,
      async () => { ... },
      { timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai' },
    )
    logger.info(...)
    return task
  } catch (e) {
    logger.error('[backup] cron 调度创建失败,保留既有调度', { err: ..., expr })
    return null
  }
}
```

startBackupCronScheduler:
```ts
export async function startBackupCronScheduler(): Promise<void> {
  if (scheduledTask) return
  const settings = await getBackupSettings().catch((e) => {
    logger.error('[backup] 读取备份配置失败,调度器未启动', { err: ... })
    return null
  })
  if (!settings?.enabled) {
    logger.info('[backup] 定时备份未启用,跳过调度(startBackupCronScheduler 仍可手动调用)')
    return
  }
  const task = scheduleWith(settings.cronExpr)
  if (!task) {
    logger.error('[backup] 调度器未启动:备份配置里的 cronExpr 非法,请通过 PATCH /api/admin/backup-jobs/settings 修正')
    return
  }
  scheduledTask = task
}
```

restartBackupCron:
```ts
export async function restartBackupCron(): Promise<void> {
  const settings = await getBackupSettings().catch((e) => {
    logger.error('[backup] 重载调度失败:读取备份配置异常,保留既有调度', {...})
    return null
  })
  if (!settings) return // 读不到配置时不要停旧任务
  if (!settings.enabled) {
    stopBackupCronScheduler()
    return
  }
  const next = scheduleWith(settings.cronExpr) // 先建新成功
  if (!next) return // 非法:保留旧任务继续跑,避免停摆
  const prev = scheduledTask
  scheduledTask = next
  if (prev) {
    prev.stop()
    logger.info('[backup] cron scheduler restarted')
  }
}
```

Actually to reduce complexity, implement helper:

```ts
type TimerHandle = ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>

function installTimerProbe() {
  const delays: number[] = []
  const handles: TimerHandle[] = []
  const cleared: TimerHandle[] = []
  const setSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout').mockImplementation(((
    handler: (...args: unknown[]) => void,
    delay?: number,
    ...args: unknown[]
  ) => {
    const handle = realSetTimeout(handler as () => void, delay, ...args) as unknown as TimerHandle
    delays.push(delay ?? 0)
    handles.push(handle)
    return handle
  }) as unknown as typeof setTimeout)
  const clearSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'clearTimeout').mockImplementation(((
    handle?: TimerHandle
  ) => {
    if (handle) cleared.push(handle)
    realClearTimeout(handle)
  }) as unknown as typeof clearTimeout)
  return { delays, handles, cleared, setSpy, clearSpy }
}
```

But careful: `realSetTimeout` captured at call time vs. when spy installed — capture module-level at import time. But vi.restoreAllMocks in afterEach restores. Capturing module-level `const realSetTimeout = globalThis.setTimeout` should be the original before any spy; safe.

Timer probe:

```ts
const realSetTimeout = globalThis.setTimeout
const realClearTimeout = globalThis.clearTimeout

type TimerHandle = ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>

interface TimerProbe {
  delays: number[]
  deadlineHandles: TimerHandle[]
  cleared: TimerHandle[]
}

function installTimerProbe(): TimerProbe { ... }
```

Implementation typings: `vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout')` expects the type of globalThis.setTimeout which is overloaded. mockImplementation with a function typed `(handler: TimerHandler, timeout?: number, ...args: unknown[]) => TimerHandle` may mismatch. Use cast: `.mockImplementation(((handler: unknown, delay?: number, ...args: unknown[]) => {...}) as typeof globalThis.setTimeout)`. TS may complain conversion insufficient overlap; use `as unknown as typeof globalThis.setTimeout`.

Inside:
```ts
const handle = realSetTimeout(handler as (...a: unknown[]) => void, delay, ...args) as unknown as TimerHandle
```
realSetTimeout overload expects `TimerHandler` for first arg, `number` timeout, `...args: any[]`. With `delay` possibly undefined; passing undefined is acceptable at runtime but types expect number|undefined (optional). Fine.

For clearTimeout spy:
```ts
vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'clearTimeout').mockImplementation(((handle?: TimerHandle) => {
  if (handle !== undefined) cleared.push(handle)
  realClearTimeout(handle)
}) as unknown as typeof globalThis.clearTimeout)
```

Hmm typing `realClearTimeout(handle)` — setTimeout returns NodeJS.Timeout, and clearTimeout accepts `NodeJS.Timeout | string | number | undefined`. In DOM+Node types conflicts could exist. Use `realClearTimeout(handle as TimerHandle)` fine.

But wait: in the helper, `timer.unref()` is called. With NodeJS.Timeout typing good.

import Fastify from 'fastify'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'

const h = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const state = {
    settings: { enabled: true, cronExpr: '0 3 * * *' } as {
      enabled: boolean
      cronExpr: string
    } | null,
  }
  const tasks: Array<{ stop: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> }> = []

    return task

  const validate = vi.fn((expr: string) => {
    const fields = expr.trim().split(/\s+/)
    return fields.length === 5 || fields.length === 6
  })

    if (state.settings === null) throw new Error('db down')
    return state.settings
  })
  const updateBackupSettings = vi.fn(async (patch: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    ...(state.settings ?? {}),
    ...patch,
  }))
  return { state, tasks, schedule, validate, getBackupSettings, updateBackupSettings }
})

```ts
const state = { inTransaction: false, updateWhereArgs: [] as unknown[], whereSnapshots: [] }
db.transaction = async (fn) => { state.inTransaction = true; try { return await fn(db) } finally { state.inTransaction = false } }

For the update chain, `.where(arg)` records arg and whether inTransaction. Then to assert pending condition, we can use drizzle's `sql`/`PgDialect`:

Actually drizzle exposes `SQL` with `queryChunks`. The where arg from `and(eq(...), eq(...))` is `SQL` object with `queryChunks` containing `StringChunk` with value arrays. We could do a recursive stringify: JSON-ish scan of the arg for 'pending' and 'status' strings. Fragile but workable:

```ts
function collectStrings(v: unknown, acc: string[] = [], depth=0): string[] {
  if (depth > 6 || v == null) return acc
  if (typeof v === 'string') { acc.push(v); return acc }
  if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (const x of v) collectStrings(x, acc, depth+1); return acc }
  if (typeof v === 'object') {
    for (const key of Object.keys(v as object)) { ... collectStrings((v as any)[key], acc, depth+1) }
  }
  return acc
}
```
Drizzle's `eq(column, 'pending')` creates Param with value 'pending' and Column objects; SQL queryChunks include StringChunk with `value: ['',' = ']` etc. The column object has `name: 'status'`. So collecting strings should include 'pending' and 'status'. Reasonable.

But be careful: drizzle `eq` with param may store value in `param[0]`? In drizzle-orm, `Param` extends SQL with `encoder`, `value`, and `queryChunks = [new StringChunk('$'), this]`. `sql` object could be traversed. Risk of infinite recursion via circular refs (Column has table reference which references columns...). Use a WeakSet to avoid cycles and depth limit.

Alternatively simpler and robust: use `PgDialect().sqlToQuery(whereArg)` from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core' to compile SQL, then check `sqlString`? For a SQL object, `dialect.sqlToQuery(sql)` works. That includes placeholders ($1) and params array containing 'pending'. That would be clean:

```ts
import { PgDialect } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'
const dialect = new PgDialect()
const q = dialect.sqlToQuery(whereArg as SQL)
expect(q.sql).toContain('"status"')
expect(q.params).toContain('pending')
```

Should we accept seconds? Let's define: 
```ts
function parseTimestamp(raw: string | undefined): number | null {
  if (!raw) return null
  const trimmed = raw.trim()
  if (!/^\d{1,16}$/.test(trimmed)) return null
  const value = Number(trimmed)
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return null
  // 兼容秒级 epoch(10 位)与毫秒级(13 位)
  return value < 1e12 ? value * 1000 : value
}
```

Signature canonical string: `${timestamp}.${rawPayload}`. Use raw timestamp as sent (so both ms and seconds forms work without ambiguity since we sign the literal header). Important: sign the exact header string, not normalized number.

```ts
function verifySignature(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string, timestamp: string): boolean {
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${timestamp}.${payload}`).digest('hex')
  return secretsEqual(expected, signature)
}
```

```ts
function extractEventKey(payload: unknown): string | null {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload)) return null
  const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  for (const field of ['eventId', 'id', 'deliveryId']) {
    const value = record[field]
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()
    if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return String(value)
  }
  return null
}
```

Claim function:
```ts
type RedisDedupLike = {
  set(key: string, value: string, mode: 'EX', ttl: number, nx: 'NX'): Promise<unknown>
  get(key: string): Promise<unknown>
}

async function claimOnce(redis, key, value): Promise<'claimed'|'duplicate'> {
  try {
    const res = await redis.set(key, value, 'EX', DEDUP_TTL_SEC, 'NX')
    return res === 'OK' ? 'claimed' : 'duplicate'
  } catch {
    // Redis 不可用 → 进程内 Set + TTL 兜底(不静默放行)
    return claimMemory(key, value)
  }
}
```

Memory claim:
```ts
function claimMemory(key: string, value: string): 'claimed' | 'duplicate' {
  const now = Date.now()
  const expiresAt = memoryDedup.get(key)
  if (expiresAt !== undefined && expiresAt > now) return 'duplicate'
  if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
    // 清过期项;仍满则淘汰最早过期的一条
    for (const [k, exp] of memoryDedup) if (exp <= now) memoryDedup.delete(k)
    if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
      const oldest = memoryDedup.keys().next().value
      if (oldest !== undefined) memoryDedup.delete(oldest)
    }
  }
  memoryDedup.set(key, now + DEDUP_TTL_SEC * 1000)
  return 'claimed'
}
```

Window:
```ts
function timestampWithinWindow(timestamp: string): { ok: boolean; parsed: number | null } {
  const value = Number(timestamp)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0) return { ok: false, parsed: null }
  const ms = value < 1e12 ? value * 1000 : value
  return { ok: Math.abs(Date.now() - ms) <= TIMESTAMP_WINDOW_MS, parsed: ms }
}
```

```ts
/** 时间戳判据:必须是正整数 epoch(秒或毫秒),且与服务器时钟偏差不超过 ±5 分钟。 */
function isTimestampFresh(raw: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{1,16}$/.test(raw)) return false
  const value = Number(raw)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0) return false
  const ms = value < 1_000_000_000_000 ? value * 1000 : value
  return Math.abs(Date.now() - ms) <= TIMESTAMP_WINDOW_MS
}
```

```ts

```ts
function claimInMemory(key: string, value: string): { duplicate: boolean; value: string } {
  const now = Date.now()
  const existing = memoryDedup.get(key)
  if (existing && existing.expiresAt > now) return { duplicate: true, value: existing.value }
  if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
    for (const [k, row] of memoryDedup) if (row.expiresAt <= now) memoryDedup.delete(k)
    if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
      const oldest = memoryDedup.keys().next().value
      if (oldest) memoryDedup.delete(oldest)
    }
  }
  memoryDedup.set(key, { expiresAt: now + DEDUP_TTL_SEC * 1000, value })
  return { duplicate: false, value }
}
```

```ts
async function claimOnce(redis: WebhookDedupRedis | undefined, key: string, value: string) {
  if (!redis || typeof redis.set !== 'function') return claimInMemory(key, value)
  try {
    const res = await redis.set(key, value, 'EX', DEDUP_TTL_SEC, 'NX')
    if (res === 'OK') return { duplicate: false, value }
    // 已有同键记录:尽力取回首次的 eventId,取不到就回 null
    let prior: string | null = null
    try {
      const got = await redis.get(key)
      prior = typeof got === 'string' && got ? got : null
    } catch { /* 读不回不影响"拒绝重复执行"这条判定 */ }
    return { duplicate: true, value: prior }
  } catch {
    return claimInMemory(key, value)
  }
}
```

Replace lines 134-146:

```ts
// =============================================================================
// 辅助函数:防重放(时间戳窗口 + 幂等去重)
// =============================================================================

/** 时间戳头:主选 X-IHUI-Timestamp,兼容既有投递方使用的 X-Webhook-Timestamp。 */
const TIMESTAMP_HEADERS = ['x-ihui-timestamp', 'x-webhook-timestamp'] as const
/** 允许的时钟偏移(双向) */
const TIMESTAMP_WINDOW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
/** 幂等键 TTL:覆盖时间戳窗口与上游重投曲线 */
const DEDUP_TTL_SEC = 24 * 60 * 60
const DEDUP_KEY_PREFIX = 'webhooks:trigger:dedup:'
/** 进程内兜底表条数硬顶(与 eventStore 同口径,防灌爆) */
const MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP = 1000
/** Redis 不可用时的进程内兜底:key → { 过期时刻, 首次 eventId } */
const memoryDedup = new Map<string, { expiresAt: number; eventId: string }>()

/** Redis 侧最小能力:SET NX EX(抢槽)+ GET(取回首次 eventId)。 */
interface DedupRedisLike {
  set(
    key: string,
    value: string,
    expiryMode: 'EX',
    ttlSeconds: number,
    mode: 'NX',
  ): Promise<unknown>
  get(key: string): Promise<unknown>
}

/**
 * HMAC-SHA256 签名验证(2026-11-11 F-72 加固)。
 * 外部系统用 config.secret 对 `${timestamp}.${rawPayload}` 计算 hex 摘要,
 * 放在 X-Webhook-Signature 头。时间戳纳入签名串,截断重放(改头不换签名)必然验签失败。
 * 经全仓唯一比较出口 secretsEqual(定长散列)防时序攻击。
 */
function verifySignature(
  payload: string,
  signature: string,
  secret: string,
  timestamp: string,
): boolean {
  const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${timestamp}.${payload}`).digest('hex')
  return secretsEqual(expected, signature)
}

/** 取原始时间戳头;缺头返回 null(调用方应当拒绝,而不是按"旧格式"放行)。 */
function readTimestampHeader(headers: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
  for (const name of TIMESTAMP_HEADERS) {
    const raw = headers[name]
    const value = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()
  }
  return null
}

/**
 * 时间戳窗口判据:正整数 epoch(秒/毫秒皆可),与服务器时钟偏差 ≤ ±5 分钟。
 * 只做格式与窗口判断;签名必须覆盖**原始头字符串**(调用方传秒或毫秒都可,但签名要对齐)。
 */
function isTimestampFresh(raw: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{1,16}$/.test(raw)) return false
  const value = Number(raw)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0) return false
  const ms = value < 1_000_000_000_000 ? value * 1000 : value
  return Math.abs(Date.now() - ms) <= TIMESTAMP_WINDOW_MS
}

/** 幂等键来源字段:支付/投递系统通常在 body 里带其中之一。 */
const DEDUP_SOURCE_FIELDS = ['eventId', 'id', 'deliveryId'] as const

/** 事件 id 优先;缺失时退回正文摘要(仍能挡住逐字节重放,不静默放行)。 */
function dedupSourceOf(payload: unknown, rawPayload: string): string {
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payload)) {
    const record = payload as Record<string, unknown>
    for (const field of DEDUP_SOURCE_FIELDS) {
      const value = record[field]
      if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()
      if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return String(value)
    }
  }
  return rawPayload
}

/** 进程内兜底抢槽(Redis 不可用时使用,绝不放行)。 */
function claimInMemory(key: string, eventId: string): { duplicate: boolean; eventId: string } {
  const now = Date.now()
  const existing = memoryDedup.get(key)
  if (existing && existing.expiresAt > now) return { duplicate: true, eventId: existing.eventId }
  if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
    for (const [k, row] of memoryDedup) {
      if (row.expiresAt <= now) memoryDedup.delete(k)
    }
    if (memoryDedup.size >= MAX_MEMORY_DEDUP) {
      const oldest = memoryDedup.keys().next().value
      if (oldest !== undefined) memoryDedup.delete(oldest)
    }
  }
  memoryDedup.set(key, { expiresAt: now + DEDUP_TTL_SEC * 1000, eventId })
  return { duplicate: false, eventId }
}

/**
 * 幂等抢槽:Redis `SET NX EX` 原子抢占;Redis 缺失/抛错时降级到进程内 Set + TTL
 * (同机多实例不共享,但绝不 silent allow)。
 */
async function claimOnce(
  redis: DedupRedisLike | undefined,
  key: string,
  eventId: string,
): Promise<{ duplicate: boolean; eventId: string }> {
  if (!redis || typeof redis.set !== 'function') return claimInMemory(key, eventId)
  try {
    const res = await redis.set(key, eventId, 'EX', DEDUP_TTL_SEC, 'NX')
    if (res === 'OK') return { duplicate: false, eventId }
    let prior: string | null = null
    try {
      const got = await redis.get(key)
      prior = typeof got === 'string' && got ? got : null
    } catch {
      /* 取不回首次 eventId 只影响响应里的回显,不影响"不重复执行"这条判定 */
    }
    return { duplicate: true, eventId: prior ?? eventId }
  } catch {
    return claimInMemory(key, eventId)
  }
}
```

```ts
// =============================================================================
// objectKey / 策略构造(纯函数,供 F-70 回归测试直接调用)
// =============================================================================

/** 直传落点前缀,与 storage-service 分片上传的 `uploads/<userId>/...` 对齐。 */
export const OSS_UPLOAD_PREFIX = 'uploads'

/** 直传单对象大小上限 50MB(与 routes/oss.ts 的 createUploadPreHandler maxSize 一致)。 */
export const OSS_MAX_OBJECT_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024

/** 用户目录段清洗:只留字母数字/_/-,避免 `../` 或 `/` 撑开策略作用域。 */
export function safeUserSegment(userId: string): string {
  return userId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_').slice(0, 64) || 'anonymous'
}

/** 策略收敛后的用户目录前缀(不带通配符):`uploads/<userId>`。 */
export function ossUserPrefix(userId: string): string {
  return `${OSS_UPLOAD_PREFIX}/${safeUserSegment(userId)}`
}

/** 生成 objectKey:`uploads/${userId}/${Date.now()}-${random8}.${ext}` */
export function generateObjectKey(userId: string, ext: string): string {
  const safeExt = ext.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 8) || 'bin'
  // 2026-08-02 P2 安全加固：用 CSPRNG 替换 Math.random，防止攻击者枚举他人文件路径
  const random = randomBytes(8).toString('hex')
  return `${ossUserPrefix(userId)}/${Date.now()}-${random}.${safeExt}`
}
```

Policy types:

```ts
export interface TencentStsPolicy {
  version: string
  statement: Array<{
    effect: 'allow'
    action: string[]
    resource: string[]
    condition?: { numeric_less_than_equal: Record<string, number> }
  }>
}

/** 腾讯云 CAM 策略:仅本人目录 + 单对象 ≤50MB。 */
export function buildTencentStsPolicy(region: string, bucket: string, userId: string): TencentStsPolicy {
  return {
    version: '2.0',
    statement: [
      {
        effect: 'allow',
        action: ['name/cos:PutObject'],
        resource: [`qcs::cos:${region}:::${bucket}/${ossUserPrefix(userId)}/*`],
        // CAM 数值条件:请求体 content-length ≤ 50MB(等价于 S3 的 content-length-range)
        condition: { numeric_less_than_equal: { 'cos:content-length': OSS_MAX_OBJECT_BYTES } },
      },
    ],
  }
}
```

Aliyun provider rewrite:

```ts
class AliyunOssProvider implements OssStsProvider {
  readonly type = 'aliyun' as const

  async assumeRole(
    sessionName: string,
    durationSeconds: number,
    ctx: StsContext,
  ): Promise<StsCredentials> {
    const config = getOssConfig()
    if (!config) {
      throw new Error('OSS 配置缺失(OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET/OSS_ROLE_ARN/OSS_BUCKET)')
    }
    // F-70:storage-service.issueStsCredentials 内的策略是整桶 `bucket/*` 且无大小条件,
    // 直传凭证必须收敛到本人目录 —— 故此处用同一 SDK 自建策略(不改 storage-service 的签名面)。
    const OpenApi = (await import('@alicloud/openapi-client')) as unknown as {
      default: new (config: unknown) => {
        callApi(params: unknown, request: unknown, runtime: unknown): Promise<{ body: Record<string, unknown> }>
      }
      Config: new (input: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown
      Params: new (input: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown
      OpenApiRequest: new (input: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown
    }
    const client = new OpenApi.default(
      new OpenApi.Config({ accessKeyId: config.accessKeyId, accessKeySecret: config.accessKeySecret, endpoint: 'sts.aliyuncs.com', protocol: 'HTTPS' }),
    )
    const params = new OpenApi.Params({ action: 'AssumeRole', version: '2015-04-01', protocol: 'HTTPS', pathname: '/', method: 'POST', authType: 'AK', bodyType: 'json', reqBodyType: 'formData', style: 'RPC' })
    const request = new OpenApi.OpenApiRequest({
      query: {
        RoleArn: config.roleArn,
        RoleSessionName: sessionName.slice(0, 32) || 'ihui-upload',
        DurationSeconds: String(durationSeconds),
        Policy: JSON.stringify(buildAliyunStsPolicy(config.bucket, ctx.userId)),
      },
    })
    const response = await client.callApi(params, request, {})
    const creds = response.body?.Credentials as
      | { AccessKeyId: string; AccessKeySecret: string; SecurityToken: string; Expiration: string }
      | undefined
    if (!creds) {
      // 失败分支只回传 Code / RequestId(与 issueStsCredentials 同口径),不透传凭据端点响应体。
      const err = response.body as { Code?: unknown; RequestId?: unknown } | undefined
      const code = typeof err?.Code === 'string' ? err.Code : 'no_code'
      const reqId = typeof err?.RequestId === 'string' ? ` req=${err.RequestId}` : ''
      throw new Error(`STS AssumeRole 失败: ${code}${reqId}`)
    }
    return {
      accessKeyId: creds.AccessKeyId,
      accessKeySecret: creds.AccessKeySecret,
      securityToken: creds.SecurityToken,
      expiration: creds.Expiration,
      bucket: config.bucket,
      region: config.region,
      objectKey: ctx.objectKey,
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
      const { ids } = body.data
      // F-66: 判态与写入一律走主库同一事务;先读副本再按旧集合无条件 UPDATE 会把
      // 期间已支付的订单改成 cancelled。条件更新带 status='pending',命中集取 RETURNING。
      const confirmedIds = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const fetched = await tx
          .select({ id: eduOrders.id, status: eduOrders.status })
          .from(eduOrders)
          .where(inArray(eduOrders.id, ids))
        const foundMap = new Map(fetched.map((o) => [o.id, o]))
        const cancellableIds: string[] = []
        for (const id of ids) {
          const o = foundMap.get(id)
          if (!o) { skipped.push(...); continue }
          if (o.status !== 'pending') { skipped.push(...); continue }
          cancellableIds.push(id)
        }
        if (cancellableIds.length === 0) return []
        const eduReturned = await tx.update(eduOrders)
          .set({...})
          .where(and(inArray(eduOrders.id, cancellableIds), eq(eduOrders.status, 'pending')))
          .returning({ id: eduOrders.id })
        const eduConfirmed = eduReturned.map(r => r.id)
        if (eduConfirmed.length === 0) return []
        // Phase 3: 同步批量取消到统一 orders 表;第二张表失败 ⇒ 整个事务回滚,第一张表不落库
        const unifiedReturned = await tx.update(ordersTable)
          .set({...})
          .where(and(inArray(ordersTable.id, eduConfirmed), eq(ordersTable.status, 'pending')))
          .returning({ id: ordersTable.id })
        const unifiedSet = new Set(unifiedReturned.map(r => r.id))
        return eduConfirmed.filter(id => unifiedSet.has(id))
      })
```

/**
 * F-66 回归(P2):管理端批量取消订单
 * ...

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest'
import Fastify, { type FastifyError } from 'fastify'
import type { SQL } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { PgDialect } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'

interface SqlCall {
  op: 'select' | 'update' | 'insert' | 'delete'
  source: 'db' | 'dbRead'
  inTx: boolean
  whereArg: unknown
  returning: boolean
}

const { state, mockLogAction } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockLogAction: vi.fn(),
  state: {
    calls: [] as Array<{
      op: string
      source: string
      inTx: boolean
      whereArg: unknown
      returning: boolean
    }>,
    selectRows: [] as unknown[],
    updateRows: [] as unknown[][],
    updateSeq: 0,
    failUpdateIndex: 0,
    txDepth: 0,
    txStarted: 0,
    txCommitted: 0,
    txRolledBack: 0,
  },
}))

vi.mock db:

```ts
vi.mock('../src/db/index.js', () => {
  const build = (op: 'select' | 'update' | 'insert' | 'delete', source: 'db' | 'dbRead') => {
    const entry = { op, source, inTx: state.txDepth > 0, whereArg: undefined as unknown, returning: false }
    state.calls.push(entry)
    const updateIndex = op === 'update' ? state.updateSeq + 1 : 0
    if (op === 'update') state.updateSeq = updateIndex
    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    const self = (): Record<string, unknown> => chain
    for (const m of ['from','set','values','orderBy','groupBy','limit','offset','for','innerJoin','leftJoin','onConflictDoNothing','onConflictDoUpdate']) chain[m] = self
    chain.where = (arg: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => { entry.whereArg = arg; return chain }
    chain.returning = (): Record<string, unknown> => { entry.returning = true; return chain }
    chain.then = (
      onFulfilled: (value: unknown) => unknown,
      onRejected?: (reason: unknown) => unknown,
    ): Promise<unknown> => {
      let result: Promise<unknown>
      if (op === 'select') result = Promise.resolve(state.selectRows)
      else if (op === 'update') {
        if (state.failUpdateIndex === updateIndex) {
          result = Promise.reject(new Error('simulated unified orders update failure'))
        } else {
          result = Promise.resolve(state.updateRows[updateIndex - 1] ?? [])
        }
      } else result = Promise.resolve([])
      return result.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)
    }
    return chain
  }
  const db = {
    select: () => build('select', 'db'),
    update: () => build('update', 'db'),
    insert: () => build('insert', 'db'),
    delete: () => build('delete', 'db'),
    execute: () => Promise.resolve([]),
    transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>): Promise<unknown> => {
      state.txStarted += 1
      state.txDepth += 1
      try {
        const result = await fn(db)
        state.txCommitted += 1
        return result
      } catch (err) {
        state.txRolledBack += 1
        throw err
      } finally {
        state.txDepth -= 1
      }
    },
  }
  const dbRead = {
    select: () => build('select', 'dbRead'),
    update: () => build('update', 'dbRead'),
    insert: () => build('insert', 'dbRead'),
    delete: () => build('delete', 'dbRead'),
    execute: () => Promise.resolve([]),
    transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>): Promise<unknown> => fn(dbRead),
  }
  return { db, dbRead, dbClient: {}, returningOne: vi.fn() }
})
```

Now legacy scan bounded. Implementation:

```ts
const HISTORY_LEGACY_SCAN_COUNT = 100
const HISTORY_LEGACY_SCAN_MAX_KEYS = 1000

async function listLegacyHistory(redis, userId, offset, limit): Promise<TerminalHistoryPage> {
  const collected: TerminalHistorySession[] = []
  const want = offset + limit + 1
  let cursor = '0'
  let scanned = 0
  do {
    const [next, keys] = await redis.scan(cursor, 'MATCH', 'terminal:session:*', 'COUNT', HISTORY_LEGACY_SCAN_COUNT)
    cursor = next
    scanned += keys.length
    // batch read
    const rows = await readHistoryRows(redis, keys.map(k => k.replace(...)))
    for (...) if meta.userId === userId push
    if (collected.length >= want) break
  } while (cursor !== '0' && scanned < HISTORY_LEGACY_SCAN_MAX_KEYS)
  collected.sort((a,b)=>b.createdAt-a.createdAt)
  const page = collected.slice(offset, offset+limit)
  const nextCursor = collected.length > offset + limit ? String(offset+limit) : null
  return { sessions: page, nextCursor }
}
```

  const offset = Number(cursor)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset)) throw ...

Limit:
```ts
function normalizeHistoryLimit(limit?: number): number {
  if (limit === undefined) return HISTORY_PAGE_DEFAULT
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw badRequest(...)
  if (limit > HISTORY_PAGE_MAX) throw badRequest(`limit 不能超过 ${HISTORY_PAGE_MAX}`)
  return limit
}
```

Now decide implementation details:

```ts
/**
 * 把 PG 的 bigint/numeric 聚合结果（drizzle 默认以字符串返回）安全转成 number。
 * - null/undefined/空串 → 0（无数据）
 * - 超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER → 钳制并 warn（不抛）
 */
export function toSafeMoneyInt(value: unknown): number {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 0
  const n = typeof value === 'bigint' ? Number(value) : typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(String(value))
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0
  const int = Math.trunc(n)
  if (int > Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) { ...warn; return Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }
  if (int < -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) { ...warn; return -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }
  return int
}
```

I'll implement:
```ts
function isDbQueryError(e: unknown): boolean {
  const code = (e as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code
  return typeof code === 'string' && /^[0-9A-Z]{5}$/.test(code)
}
```
Then in catches:
```ts
} catch (e) {
  request.log.error({ err: e }, 'stats/dashboard 查询失败')
  if (isDbQueryError(e)) return reply.status(500).send(error(500, '统计查询失败'))
  // 非 SQLSTATE 的历史兜底：旧库缺表等场景保持零值，避免阻塞看板
  return reply.send(success({...zeros}))

Implementation:

```ts
export async function settlePreDeductionStrict(
  pre: PreDeduction,
  actualTokens: number,
  actualCostCents: number,
): Promise<SettlePreDeductionResult> {
  // 订阅窗口只消费一次(重试只重放余额调整,避免窗口用量被重复累加)
  try {
    await consumeSubscriptionWindowUsage(pre.userId, Math.max(0, actualTokens), Math.max(0, actualCostCents))
  } catch { /* 内部已吞错,这里再兜一层不影响结算 */ }

  const deltaTokens = pre.tokens - Math.max(0, actualTokens)
  const deltaCents = pre.cents - Math.max(0, actualCostCents)
  if (deltaTokens === 0 && deltaCents === 0) return { ok: true, attempts: 0 }

  let lastError: unknown
  let attempts = 0
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= SETTLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
    attempts = attempt
    try {
      await applySettlementDelta(pre, deltaTokens, deltaCents)
      return { ok: true, attempts }
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err
      if (attempt < SETTLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        await sleep(SETTLE_RETRY_DELAYS_MS[attempt - 1] ?? 50)
      }
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, attempts, reason: lastError instanceof Error ? lastError.message : String(lastError) }
}
```

Read helpers:

```ts
interface HistoryRow {
  id: string
  meta: Record<string, string>
  scrollbackLines: number
}

/**
 * 批量读取会话元数据 + scrollback 行数:一次 pipeline 往返,替代逐 key hgetall/llen。
 */
async function readHistoryRows(redis: IORedis, sessionIds: string[]): Promise<HistoryRow[]> {
  if (sessionIds.length === 0) return []
  const pipe = redis.pipeline()
  for (const id of sessionIds) {
    pipe.hgetall(sessionMetaKey(id))
    pipe.llen(scrollbackKey(id))
  }
  const replies = (await pipe.exec()) ?? []
  const rows: HistoryRow[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < sessionIds.length; i++) {
    const id = sessionIds[i]!
    const metaReply = replies[i * 2]
    const linesReply = replies[i * 2 + 1]
    const meta = (metaReply?.[1] ?? null) as Record<string, string> | null
    const linesRaw = linesReply?.[1]
    if (!meta || typeof meta !== 'object') continue
    rows.push({
      id,
      meta,
      scrollbackLines: Number(linesRaw ?? 0) || 0,
    })
  }
  return rows
}
```

function toHistorySession(row: HistoryRow): TerminalHistorySession {
  const { meta } = row
  return {
    id: row.id,
    shell: meta.shell ?? '',
    kind: (meta.kind === 'ssh' ? 'ssh' : 'local') as TerminalConnectKind,
    cwd: meta.cwd ?? '',
    sshHost: meta.sshHost || undefined,
    sshUser: meta.sshUser || undefined,
    createdAt: Number(meta.createdAt ?? 0),
    lastActivityAt: Number(meta.lastActivityAt ?? 0),
    exitCode: meta.exitCode !== undefined ? Number(meta.exitCode) : undefined,
    scrollbackLines: row.scrollbackLines,
  }
}
```

Error helper:
```ts
function historyPaginationError(message: string): Error {
  const err = new Error(message) as Error & { statusCode?: number; errorCode?: string }
  err.statusCode = 400
  err.errorCode = 'invalid_history_pagination'
  return err
}
```

parse:
```ts
function parseHistoryLimit(limit: number | undefined): number {
  if (limit === undefined) return HISTORY_PAGE_DEFAULT
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw historyPaginationError('limit 必须是正整数')
  if (limit > TERMINAL_HISTORY_PAGE_MAX) throw historyPaginationError(`limit 不能超过 ${TERMINAL_HISTORY_PAGE_MAX}`)
  return limit
}

function parseHistoryCursor(cursor: string | undefined): number {
  if (cursor === undefined || cursor === '') return 0
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(cursor)) throw historyPaginationError('cursor 非法')
  const offset = Number(cursor)
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset)) throw historyPaginationError('cursor 非法')
  return offset
}
```
